purpose: Supplement the existing own-tool validation run-plan after the native CD source picker did not respond; preserve original binaries, dataCD, policy and full objective.
authorization_basis: Current user Windows, network-testing and tool/dependency authorization; no new original game or used script operation is performed by this task tool.
supersedes_only: run-plan.json steps2/3 media transport may instead use this bounded own-file transfer
Input recovery temporarily enabled the ordinary host on-screen keyboard and restored it off; no analysis/security/approval or VM network/share policy was changed.

limits.source_identity: Exact pinned byte counts and SHA256 are checked before any listener opens; sources are cached in memory.
limits.NAT_allowed_GET_peer: 10.211.55.3, must refresh actual guest identity before live use
limits.port: OS-selected ephemeral; use only the newly observed ready port
limits.TTL_seconds: 10..600, bounded per-request socket timeouts may overrun the loop deadline
limits.responses: One GET per exact filename; auto-close after both response sends or expiry; a send is not guest hash acceptance.
limits.HEAD: Metadata only; host HEAD also allowed in NAT mode
limits.other_paths_or_methods: No directory listing, request-derived filesystem access, uploads, ranged or non-empty-body GETs; fixed empty error bodies; request lines/headers are not logged.

ordered_steps: Recover ordinary Mac access, inspect the last open configuration window and then a verified idle English PowerShell prompt; do not press Return across unknown dialogs.
Refresh actual Windows NAT identity and fixed own destination/root attributes; stop on ambiguous path, reparse object or unexpected pre-existing files.

Start a new bounded NAT-only helper only when the guest is ready, verify the emitted bind/allowed peer/port, then use a metadata HEAD from Windows; if denied or unreachable, stop without changing firewall, network/share configuration or source guards.

Read the two fixed own payloads only, clear stale buffers between downloads and create destination files atomically with FileMode.CreateNew; verify exact byte counts, attributes and full SHA256 before any invocation.
Confirm transport has closed; keep the old stage89 dataCD and all original files/backups untouched.
Run the existing own observer input/path denial cases and one fresh own fixture PID observation, retain actual status/exit/numeric metadata and natural fixture exit.

Only then establish legitimate normal original-game path/context. The compiled game profile points at an absent path and is currently unready; do not relocate the game or relax guards to make it pass.
unchanged_guards: No current.ps1/Restore or consumed launch replay, credential/session/code/IPC read, debugger/injection/privilege or protection change.
No ExecutionPolicy, VM hardware/network/share, global analysis-tool or approval configuration change.
Existing fixed source/path/architecture/creation/module/RVA/exact8byte guards remain compiled. Denial stops.
actual_validation: transfer-host-validation-stage101.json: nineteen host protocol/policy/closure checks, no positive guest GET or Windows execution.

official_reference.claim: Mac shared-network IPv4 default is10.211.55.2; actual bind success was independently checked. This is not proof of guest reachability.
